Original address 1, row 0, work 1 has loaded address 2 and exits address 6, so the sum can indeed fail. Thus the answer's earlier 'can be wrong' is defensible but its later unconditional simultaneous-failure assertion is false; merely lacking a clean-branch certificate must not be converted into universal failure.
